page.notes: The first word of the page, "rum", is the end of a word begun on the previous page. Doubtful: the first letter of "bostium" (read as b, possibly h), marked [?]. The printed long s is rendered as f throughout and has been transcribed as s. The faint signature mark at the lower left is not transcribed. Possible show-through and edge marks at the right were left out.
